title: A combinatorial evaluation of TiZrV0.5Nb0.5Six refractory high entropy alloys: Microstructure, mechanical properties, wear and oxidation behaviors
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc-melting from Ti, Zr, V, Nb and Si elements of 99.5 wt% purity. Each ingot was flipped over and remelted at least six times and then molded into a plate by the casting process. Subsequently, the alloys were annealed for 24 h and hot pressed with a pressure of 30 MPa for 30 min under high vacuum conditions in a high vacuum hot pressing sintering furnace at 1100°C to achieve further homogenization and densification.
